rows.details: Master Degree with at least 55% marks, Ph.D. and 15 years as Professor / Associate Professor
Nowboicha College, P.O- Nowboicha, Dist- Lakhimpur, Assam
Application addressed to the President, Governing Body, Nowboicha College, Nowboicha
Within 15 days from the date of publication (about 15 November 2026, 15 days from 31 October 2026)

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Address the application to: The President, Governing Body, Nowboicha College, Nowboicha. The notice does not mention a postal mode such as speed post or registered post, and it does not say what to write on the envelope. Use the prescribed proforma issued by the DHE, Assam. The notice says this proforma is available on the College/DHE, Assam website ( www.nowboichacollege.ac.in ). It is titled "Application Form for the Post of Principal (Provincialised Colleges) in Assam" and is also printed in the notice in two parts: For conference, seminar or workshop participation, the form gives these points: International 7 each, National 6 each, Regional / State 5 each, Local 3 each. The application must be submitted through the proper channel with an NOC from the concerned authority.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: A Master Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed) by a recognized University. A Ph.D. degree in concerned/allied/relevant discipline(s) in the institutions concerned, with evidence of published work. Professor / Associate Professor with a total service/experience of 15 (fifteen) years of teaching/research in university, college and other institutions of Higher education or Research institutions. A minimum score as stipulated in the Academic Performance Indicator (API) based on the Performance Based Appraisal System (PBAS), as set in the UGC regulations in Appendix III for direct recruitment of Professor in Colleges. A minimum of 10 research paper publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-Listed Journals (self-attested valid supporting documents). A minimum of 110 research score as per Appendix-II at Table 2 (UGC guidelines dated 18/07/2018). The upper age limit is 55 years as prescribed rules. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. A relaxation of 5% of marks may be provided at the Graduate and Master's level for the Scheduled Caste/Tribes/Differently abled (Physical and Visually Differently Abled) categories, for the purpose of eligibility and for assessing good academic records. The eligibility marks of 55% (or an equivalent grade) and the 5% relaxation for these categories are based only on the qualifying marks, without including any grace mark procedures. A relaxation of 5% marks, from 55% to 50%, may be provided to Ph.D. Degree holders who obtained their Master's Degree prior to 19 September 1991. The term of the Principal shall be 5 years. The pay is not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: A non-refundable demand draft of Rs.5000.00/- (Rupees Five Thousand only) in favour of Principal, Nowboicha College. Complete bio-data. Attested copies of all required testimonials from HSLC onwards. The duly filled prescribed proforma issued by the DHE, Assam. An NOC from the concerned authority, as the application goes through the proper channel. Self-attested valid supporting documents for the research papers. A category document, if the candidate belongs to the SC/ST/OBC category (as the form asks). Certificates for participation in the corporate life of the institution (from the Head of the Institution), teaching experience, research experience, research guidance and administrative experience, which the form says are to be produced.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are scrutinised first. Incomplete or defective applications will be rejected at the time of scrutiny, and no call letter will be issued to those applicants. Candidates are then called for interview. Call letters will be issued in due course of time to the candidate's email as well as through WhatsApp. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: TA/DA will not be paid to the candidates called for interview. A working Principal in any Provincialized/Government College may apply with proper permission from the competent authority. The demand draft fee of Rs.5000.00/- is non-refundable. Give a valid email address and a WhatsApp-reachable phone number in the form, because call letters are sent through these. For queries, the letterhead gives Mobile No. 6000067739 and Mail ID [email protected] (Office of the President, Governing Body).

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Nowboicha College Principal post?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement. That is about 15 November 2026 when counted from the covering letter dated 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is required for the Principal post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master Degree with at least 55% marks from a recognized University and a Ph.D. in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline with evidence of published work. They also need at least 10 research papers and a minimum research score of 110.

faq.question: Q3. How much experience is needed?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a Professor / Associate Professor with a total service/experience of 15 years of teaching/research in a university, college or other institution of higher education or research.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Nowboicha College Principal post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 55 years as prescribed rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is a non-refundable demand draft of Rs.5000.00/- in favour of Principal, Nowboicha College.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the Nowboicha College Principal post?
faq.answer: Fill the DHE, Assam proforma and attach the demand draft, your bio-data and attested testimonials from HSLC onwards. Send the application through the proper channel with an NOC, addressed to the President, Governing Body, Nowboicha College, Nowboicha.

faq.question: Q7. How will the Principal be selected?
faq.answer: Applications are scrutinised and defective ones are rejected. Eligible candidates receive interview call letters by email and WhatsApp.

faq.question: Q8. What is the term of the Principal's appointment?
faq.answer: The term of the Principal shall be 5 years.

faq.question: Q9. Is any relaxation in marks available?
faq.answer: A 5% relaxation at Graduate and Master's level may be given to SC/ST/Differently abled candidates. A relaxation from 55% to 50% may be given to Ph.D. holders who obtained their Master's Degree before 19 September 1991.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. TA/DA will not be paid to candidates called for interview.
